lines.text: ช่วย ด้วย
น้ำ มา
Cold. Something pulling at me. Someone is shouting, far away.
ปลา
Warm. Dry. A roof over me. My head is pounding.
I can't remember anything. Not even my own name.
Something in my pocket: a soggy scrap of card. The printing has run into blue smears. Only a few numbers survive.
คุณ ตื่น แล้ว
Her words slide right past me. I can't hold on to a single sound.
ฉัน ชื่อ มะลิ

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: คุณ ชื่อ อะไร
She mimes putting food in her mouth, then points at me. Slowly this time.

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: หิว ไหม

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: กิน ข้าว
She hands me a bowl of rice. It's still warm.

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: ไม่ หิว ไหม

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: ไม่เป็นไร
She leaves a bowl of rice beside me anyway.
She sits down across from me and points at herself.

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: ฉัน ชื่อ มะลิ
One sound at a time.

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: มะลิ
She points at herself again, and waits for me.

reactions.text: ฉัน ชื่อ มะลิ

lines.text: Her mouth twitches. She shakes her head, taps her own chest, then mine.

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: มะลิ
Just her name, then. I say it back and she nods.

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: ใช่

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: คุณ ชื่อ อะไร
I open my mouth and nothing comes. There's nothing there to say.

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: คุณ จำ ไม่ ได้
She doesn't seem surprised.

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: ไม่เป็นไร

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: คุณ ตื่น แล้ว

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: คุณ หิว ไหม

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: กิน ข้าว
The noise is starting to come apart into words. Maybe she'll tell me what other things are called.

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: อย่า ไป ข้างนอก
Her voice is quiet, but she means it.

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: คุณ จำ ได้ ไหม
Mali puts a plate of rice and fish in front of me. Lunch. The old woman sits at the far end of the table and won't look at me.

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: กิน ข้าว
I take the plate without a word. The old woman snaps something at Mali, sharp as a slap.
Mali goes a little pink. She presses her palms together and bows her head to me. She says it slowly, like it matters.

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: ขอบคุณ ค่ะ
Then she points at me and says it again, but it ends differently.

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: ขอบคุณ ครับ
She waits.

tiles.answer: ขอบคุณ ครับ

reactions.text: ขอบคุณ ค่ะ

lines.text: Mali covers her mouth with her hand, but I can see she's laughing.
She taps her own chest.

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: ค่ะ
Then mine.

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: ครับ
One more time, then.

tiles.answer: ขอบคุณ ครับ

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: ไม่เป็นไร

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: ไม่เป็นไร ค่ะ
She just nods and starts eating.
She almost smiles before she catches herself.
The old woman sniffs, as if it'll do, gets up and leaves without another word.
Someone bangs on the door. A man's voice, rough and cheerful, calling from outside.
I hold out Lung Daeng's hundred baht note to Mali.

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: อะไร
She wants to know where I got it.

tiles.prompt: Tell her you worked for it
accept: ผม ทำงาน ครับ

reactions.text: ฉัน ทำงาน

lines.text: Her eyebrows go up. She taps my chest, the way Lung Daeng did.

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: ผม
Right. Again.

tiles.prompt: Tell her you worked for it
accept: ผม ทำงาน ครับ

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: ทำงาน ดี
She's fed me for two days. She's the reason I'm not in the sea.

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: ขอบคุณ ค่ะ
The first time she's said it to me.

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: ขอบคุณ
She says it short and flat, and tucks the note away quickly.
I put it back in my pocket. She doesn't say anything. She doesn't need to.
I hum it under my breath. Across the room, Mali goes very still.

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: เพลง นี้
She stops what she's doing. She doesn't turn around.

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: ไป นอน
She turns the lamp down without another word.
There's nothing to do but lie down in the dark.
I hold the photo out to her.

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: ใคร
Her voice is sharp.

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: ฉัน ไม่ รู้
She barely looks at it.

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: เอา มา
She takes it from me and puts it back on the shelf, face down.
Something changes in her face. Like a door swinging shut.

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: คุณ เป็น ใคร
She looks at me like I'm a stranger again. Like she's never seen me before.
Mali sets a cup of water down beside me without a word.
When I look up she's already turned away. But she left it there.
An old man in a faded red cap, grease up to his elbows. He grins at me like we've met before.

lines.speaker: ลุงแดง
lines.text: มา ช่วย หน่อย
He jerks his thumb at a generator, half buried in wet sand.

lines.speaker: ลุงแดง
lines.text: เติม น้ำมัน
He unscrews a cap on the generator and nods at the red can by my feet.

choices.text: Pour the can into the generator

lines.speaker: ลุงแดง
lines.text: ไม่ ไม่
He laughs and taps the red can.

lines.speaker: ลุงแดง
lines.text: น้ำมัน
The can, then. It smells like petrol.
We lift the generator onto a cart. He takes the front and waits for me to steer.

lines.speaker: ลุงแดง
lines.text: ซ้าย
The wheel sinks into the sand. He grabs my left hand and waggles it.

lines.speaker: ลุงแดง
lines.text: ซ้าย
A fallen palm blocks the path to the house.

lines.speaker: ลุงแดง
lines.text: ขวา
We bump straight into the palm. He slaps my right arm, not too hard.

lines.speaker: ลุงแดง
lines.text: ขวา
He puts the starter cord in my hand and holds up his fingers, one at a time.

lines.speaker: ลุงแดง
lines.text: หนึ่ง สอง สาม
The cord snaps back and nearly takes my fingers with it. He shakes his head and counts again.

lines.speaker: ลุงแดง
lines.text: หนึ่ง สอง สาม
On the last one this time.
The engine coughs, catches and roars. Sparks spit from a loose wire right next to my hand.

lines.speaker: ลุงแดง
lines.text: ระวัง
A jolt of pain runs up my arm. He yanks me back by the collar.

lines.speaker: ลุงแดง
lines.text: ระวัง
I won't forget that word.
Inside, the lights flicker on. I hear Mali laugh in surprise.

lines.speaker: ลุงแดง
lines.text: ทำงาน ดี
He pulls a crumpled note from his pocket and presses it into my hand.

lines.speaker: ลุงแดง
lines.text: ร้อย บาท

lines.speaker: ลุงแดง
lines.text: คุณ ชื่อ อะไร

choices.text: ฉัน จำ ไม่ ได้

lines.text: He bursts out laughing and slaps his knee.

lines.speaker: ลุงแดง
lines.text: ผม
He thumps his own chest, then mine, and says it again with my words.

lines.speaker: ลุงแดง
lines.text: ผม จำ ไม่ ได้
So I've been talking like Mali this whole time. Of course I have. She's the only one who's taught me anything.
He shrugs back, twice as big, then thumps his chest and points at the generator.

lines.speaker: ลุงแดง
lines.text: ผม ทำงาน
Then he points at me.

lines.speaker: ลุงแดง
lines.text: คุณ ทำงาน ดี
Lung Daeng has a little radio on the generator, turned up loud. A woman is reading the news, fast.

lines.speaker: วิทยุ
lines.text: เมื่อคืน เรือ โดยสาร ล่ม กลาง ทะเล มี คน หาย หลาย คน
Lung Daeng switches it off. He doesn't look at me.
Without meaning to, I've put my hand in my pocket. The ferry ticket.

lines.speaker: ลุงแดง
lines.text: ทำงาน ดี
He's crouched by the generator, poking at it with a screwdriver.
Mali gets there first and lifts the plank off the door. She looks at me, then out at the yard.

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: ไป
Just this once, then.
Lamplight inside. From out here the house looks smaller than it feels.
A generator, half buried in wet sand. Someone has already dug one side of it out by hand.
It shudders and roars. The air around it smells of petrol.
A little house on a post, the size of a doll's house, knocked flat into the mud. Someone had left it garlands and a glass of red drink.
It feels wrong to leave it lying there. It feels just as wrong to touch it.
เรือ
A long wooden boat, upside down against the fence. Coloured ribbons are still tied to the prow.
A palm tree has come down across the path. The path goes on beyond it, inland.
Boards, a blue plastic chair, a single sandal. None of it came from this house.
เตียง
The sheets are still warm. I must have slept here.
หน้าต่าง
The yard outside is a mess of broken boards and seaweed. A little spirit house lies on its side in the mud.
Mali comes to stand beside me and points at an upturned hull, wedged against the fence.

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: เรือ
She looks at it for a long time before she turns away.
กระจก
A stranger looks back at me. Someone has cleaned the cut over my eye and taped it shut.
ประตู
It's barred from the inside with a plank. Through the gap I can hear the sea, much too close.
My hand is on the plank when I feel Mali watching me.

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: อย่า
Just that one word, cold enough that I let go.
โต๊ะ
A low table. Two bowls, two spoons. She was expecting me to wake up.
น้ำ
A clay jar full of rainwater. The tap water must be gone.
ตะเกียง
An oil lamp. With the power out, it's all the light there is.
The flame gutters. A tune comes into my head from nowhere. Something slow, for falling asleep to.
หนังสือ
Rows of old books, swollen with damp. I can't read a single title.
Tucked between two books, an old class photo, curled from the damp. Rows of children in white shirts, squinting into the sun.
One face has been scratched away.
Whoever did it pressed hard.
Footsteps on the stairs outside. Voices, coming closer.
ปฏิทิน
Someone has been crossing off the days. Further on, one date is circled in red, with a full moon and a little lotus-shaped float drawn beside it.
เสื้อ
My own clothes, hung up to dry, still stiff with salt. The ones I'm wearing are borrowed. They're a man's, and they almost fit.
รูป
A little shrine on a cliff over the sea, under a full moon. It's the only thing in the room the water didn't touch.
แมว
เหมียว
It pads straight over and leans against my leg, like it always does.
Mali crouches by the table with a saucer of rice and calls across the room, quick and sing-song.

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: มา นี่ แมว น้อย มา กิน ข้าว
The cat ignores her completely and stays with me. Mali gives it a betrayed look.

lines.text: เตียง

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: รูป

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: แมว
The lamp has burned low. Mali has gone quiet on the far side of the room.
It's dark out. Mali is counting coins into a biscuit tin, her lips moving.
I could sleep.
I lie down. The mattress still smells of the sea.
Sleep comes in pieces.
Light on water, too bright to look at. Warm sand under my knees.
Somewhere behind me, a girl is laughing.

lines.speaker: เด็ก
lines.text: ทะเล
A boy's voice. Small, and very sure of itself.
I know that voice. I don't know how I know it.
The same beach. The tide is out, and the rocks are steaming in the sun.

lines.speaker: เด็กหญิง
lines.text: ปลา มา นี่ เร็ว
A girl, shouting across the sand. Calling someone over.
A small hand opens in front of my face. A shell, striped pink and white.

lines.speaker: เด็ก
lines.text: หอย
It was my hand. I was the one who said it.
I wake in the dark. No sound but the sea.
Light flickers outside the window. Someone has carried the oil lamp into the yard.
The old woman is kneeling at the spirit house, rocking, whispering fast.

lines.speaker: ยายบัว
lines.text: ขอ อย่า ให้ เขา จำ ได้ ขอ ให้ เป็น ไป ตาม

lines.speaker: ยายบัว
lines.text: สัญญา
That one word comes through perfectly clear, as if she said it into my ear.
I've never heard it before. I have no idea what it means.
She stops whispering. Slowly, she turns her head toward my window.
Grey light. The house is quiet.
Mali's gone. There's a bowl on the table under a cloth, and a note.
Through the gap by the door I can see it's fastened from outside. I'm not going anywhere until she's back.
Rain on the roof, then birds.
The door's open a crack. Out in the yard, Mali is talking quietly to someone. Or to something.
The house is empty again.
The door is standing open. On the table, next to a covered bowl, is the key.
Down the lane, past where the palm fell, is the town.
Rice under a cloth, still a little warm. Beside it, a note in quick, slanting handwriting, with a little drawing of a bowl.
กิน ข้าว ก่อน นะ เดี๋ยว มา
I can't read most of it. I understand the drawing.
The key, on a loop of red string. She left it where I couldn't miss it.
Footsteps on the stairs. Something scrapes outside, and the door swings in.
Mali, with a basket on her hip. Behind her, a tiny old woman leaning on a stick, already talking.

lines.speaker: ยายบัว
lines.text: มะลิ ไป ไหน มา ทำไม ไม่ บอก ยาย ก่อน ฝน จะ ตก อีก แล้ว
Then she sees me.
The basket drops. Limes roll across the floor. Her hand goes to an amulet at her throat and holds on.

lines.speaker: ยายบัว
lines.text: ไม่ ... ไม่ ใช่

lines.speaker: ยายบัว
lines.text: ส่ง เขา ไป

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: เขา ไม่ มี ที่ ไป
They talk over each other, too fast. I only catch the shape of it: the old woman wants something gone, and Mali won't let it go.
The old woman doesn't look at me again. Not once.
She keeps her eyes on the floor. Her fingers keep worrying the amulet at her throat.
Mali is unpacking the basket. Somehow she always ends up standing between me and the old woman.
Mali is sweeping water out of the doorway. She doesn't stop when I come near, but she doesn't move away either.
Mali is mending a net by the window. She glances at the door, then at me, then back at the net.
Lung Daeng is shouting something cheerful out in the yard.
Mali is crouched over the fallen spirit house, trying to lift it by herself.

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: มา ช่วย หน่อย
Together we stand it back on its post. It's heavier than it looks.
She sets out a fresh glass of red drink, then hangs a string of small white flowers over the doorway.

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: ดอก มะลิ
Mali. Her name is a flower.
She presses her palms together and bows her head to the little house.

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: ไหว้

choices.text: Copy her: palms together, head bowed

lines.text: She takes both my hands and presses them together herself, firmly, like I'm six.

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: ไหว้
I bow. She lets go.
The cat drops from the fence onto the little roof, hops down, and walks straight to me.

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: แปลก

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: มัน ไม่ ชอบ ใคร
She looks from the cat to me as if we've both done something wrong.
The little house stands straight again. Fresh jasmine over its door, a glass of red drink, a stick of incense burned down to the stub.
Wax from the old woman's lamp has dripped down the post.
I hold out the soggy scrap of card. He turns it over in his big hands, very gently.

lines.speaker: ลุงแดง
lines.text: จ่า ชัย มี รายชื่อ คน บน เรือ ไป ถาม ให้
Too fast. But he taps the ticket, then points inland, toward town. Someone there can do something with this.
He hands it back and squeezes my shoulder.
I leave it where it is. Whoever I was, I'm not ready to find out yet.
Lung Daeng has a long saw over his shoulder. He nods at the fallen palm and grins.

lines.speaker: ลุงแดง
lines.text: มา ช่วย หน่อย
We take one end of the saw each. He counts us in.

lines.speaker: ลุงแดง
lines.text: หนึ่ง สอง สาม
The saw jams and bucks in the cut. He laughs and holds his fingers up again.

lines.speaker: ลุงแดง
lines.text: หนึ่ง สอง สาม
On three this time. It bites.
It takes most of an hour. When the last piece rolls off the path, the gap in the hedge is open.
A muddy lane runs on beyond it, between other people's houses.
Lung Daeng wipes his face with his rag, then hands me an empty bucket.

lines.speaker: ลุงแดง
lines.text: ไป เอา น้ำ มา
He points down the lane. Mali's rule was the yard. But he's already turned back to the generator.

lines.speaker: ลุงแดง
lines.text: ไป เอา น้ำ มา
He points down the lane again, past the cut-up palm.
I set the bucket down by the generator. He tips some into the engine and the rest over his own head.

lines.speaker: ลุงแดง
lines.text: ทำงาน ดี
He fishes in his pocket.

lines.speaker: ลุงแดง
lines.text: ห้าสิบ บาท
Half of last time. He shrugs, as if to say: half the work.
Back to the yard.
Nobody answers. There's a tide line halfway up the door, and the sour smell of wet rice sacks.
Dark inside. Someone has stacked the furniture on the bed to keep it out of the water.
A radio is playing somewhere inside, and a pot of something is bubbling. This house got off lightly.
น้ำ
A concrete rain jar, taller than me, with a tin lid weighed down by a stone.
I lift the lid and fill the bucket to the brim. It's heavy enough to pull my shoulder down.
A noodle stall, shoved sideways by the water. The glass case is cracked, and a plastic stool lies upside down beside it like a turtle.
Fishing nets heaped on the sand, orange floats tangled through them. Someone started picking them apart and gave up.
A woman is hanging soaked laundry between two posts. She stops with a sarong in her hands and looks me up and down.

lines.speaker: พี่น้อย
lines.text: อ้าว ฝรั่ง ของ มะลิ เหรอ
Mali's name, and a look toward Mali's house. Then a laugh that isn't entirely friendly.

lines.speaker: พี่น้อย
lines.text: มะลิ ไม่ เคย ให้ ใคร มา อยู่ ด้วย เลย นะ
Whatever it was, she enjoyed saying it.
She's pretending not to watch me. She's very bad at it.
A small girl in a muddy school shirt is poking a crab with a stick. She looks up at me, then all the way up.

lines.speaker: น้องฟ้า
lines.text: พี่ ชื่อ อะไร
She wants my name. She isn't going to stop asking until she gets an answer.

tiles.answer: ผม จำ ไม่ ได้

reactions.text: ฉัน จำ ไม่ ได้

lines.text: She shrieks with laughter and jabs a finger at my chest.

lines.speaker: น้องฟ้า
lines.text: ผม
Even the kids know. Fine.
Again, properly.

tiles.answer: ผม จำ ไม่ ได้
accept: ผม จำ ไม่ ได้ ครับ

lines.text: She considers this very seriously.

lines.speaker: น้องฟ้า
lines.text: จำ ไม่ ได้ เหรอ
Then she shrugs, drops the stick and runs off down the lane, telling the whole street.
The girl from yesterday is sitting on a wall, swinging her legs. She waves at me like we're old friends.
The lane bends toward town. Roofs, a temple spire, smoke from cooking fires.
Mali said the yard. I've already pushed that further than she'd like.
The lane bends toward town. Roofs, a temple spire, smoke from cooking fires. People.
They'll ask who I am, and I'll tell them what she told me to.
ผม เป็น ลูกพี่ลูกน้อง ของ มะลิ
Whether it's true or not.
Town. When I'm ready.
Evening. Mali sits down across from me with her hands in her lap. She's been working up to something all day.

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: พรุ่งนี้ คุณ ไป ตลาด ได้ แต่ ถ้า ใคร ถาม ต้อง พูด แบบ นี้
Too fast. Then she stops, and starts again slowly. She points at me, then at herself.
It isn't a request.
She almost smiles. Almost.

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: ผม เป็น ลูกพี่ลูกน้อง ของ มะลิ
She stumbles on the long word in the middle, as if it's the wrong one.

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: ลูกพี่ลูกน้อง
She waits for me to say it back.

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: ผม
Again.

lines.text: She shakes her head and says it again, slowly, tapping the table once for every word.

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: ผม ... เป็น ... ลูกพี่ลูกน้อง ... ของ ... มะลิ

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: ดี

lines.speaker: มะลิ
lines.text: ดี ค่ะ
She unhooks a key on a loop of red string from around her neck and sets it on the table between us.
Then she turns the lamp down and goes to bed without another word.
